stories.headline: Supermarine snatch top spot in stoppage time
stories.body: Swindon Supermarine returned to the summit after a 2-1 win at Larkhall Athletic, Jowan Partridge scoring in the 93rd minute after Ben Cleary had cancelled out Brad Hooper's opener.

stories.headline: Barry brace gets Barnstaple moving again
stories.body: Barnstaple Town ended their winless run with a 2-0 victory away to Willand Rovers, Joshua Barry scoring both goals as Barum climbed the table.

stories.headline: Dorchester make it nine league wins in a row
stories.body: Dorchester Town kept their remarkable run going with a 3-0 success against Melksham Town. Matty Burrows struck twice and Freddie Beale added the other goal as the Magpies moved back to the top.

stories.headline: Weymouth climb to second with another clean sheet
stories.body: Weymouth continued their strong start with a 1-0 win over Westbury United, Tom Bearish scoring the only goal as the Terras moved into second place.
